messages:
jamie: Quick heads-up — I'm about to merge PR https://git.redwood/infra/pull/5128 but I don't want to land without a design anchor. This changes shard-routing fallback and the KV-cache tunables; it looks low-risk but can affect cold-start latency. Can someone attach the RFC/design doc or tell me where to link? also need a recommended canary window. cc @ravi @alice

ravi: Can you paste the RFC link and a short SLO delta (p50/p95)? If the change could impact p95 tail, we should do a longer canary and have rollback criteria.

maria: From the perf harness: short sequences (<=128) saw ~+1.8% p50 and negligible p95 change on cpu-bound tests. Longer sequences unchanged. I pushed the raw numbers to https://gist.redwood.com/gh/maria/kv-cache-harness — not a blocker but worth noting.

chen: FYI staging integration is failing on the new shard leader election test:
```
ERROR: shard-swap timed out after 60s
    at leader_election_test.go:132
```
Repro locally with `make test-integration STAGE=staging`. Might be related to the fallback behavior.

deploy-bot: CI / integration-tests/staging — failed — 1 failing test — https://ci.redwood/runs/99821 (logs attached)

jamie: thanks @chen @maria. I'll run the staging repro now and add the RFC link. I think the test is flakey because the new fallback delays leader pickup by a small jitter — will tighten timeout and re-run. For canary: thinking 2h at 30% traffic, then extend to 6h if no regressions. Open to adjustments.

jamie: RFC link: https://redwood-internal.notion/s/shard-routing-fallback-2026-02 (adds design section + safety checklist). I've also updated PR description with the RFC and the harness gist.

alice: I can review the RFC and the PR tonight. For canary: if we expect any p50 impact, do 4h at 20% and automated rollback on p95 > baseline + 5%. For routing/fallback changes we want a conservative rollout. Marking myself to review.

ravi: FYI for SLO approvals — we'll need: 1) RFC attached, 2) perf harness results (linked), 3) rollback criteria in the PR description. Once those are present I can give architecture sign-off.

jamie: added rollback criteria to PR (monitoring alert if p95 increases by >5% for 10min or error-rate +0.5%). PTAL @ravi @alice. Also fixed the staging test timeout and re-ran CI — all green now.

alice: Read the RFC, quick comment on the fallback backoff values (nit) but nothing blocking. I'm fine with arch-wise: :thumbsup: — recommending canary: 3h at 25% then 6h at 50% before full.

ravi: arch sign-off from me once you address the nit in the doc (small numeric tweak). Please add the follow-up as a small PR to the RFC text so we have history.

jamie: will make the tiny doc update and then merge. Plan: merge Friday 09:00 PT, canary 3h @25% then 6h @50%. I'll monitor dashboards and post updates in #incidents if anything spikes. Thanks all!
